score_objections.objection: None of the sources address semiconductor export controls or chip sales. The evidence is generic 'don't cede AI leadership to China' race framing (Tufts 2026, Hurd-Kelly 2020), which is compatible with either tightening or loosening chip exports. A -1 'Leans hawkish' score is an inference from his China committee seat and rhetoric, not from any stated chip position.

score_objections.objection: The only data-center source is a news article showing Pressley joined a 'Toxic Tour' that drove past xAI's Colossus 1; she is not quoted on data centers, ratepayers, energy, or permitting anywhere in the sources. The tour was environmental-justice framed (pollution, gas turbines), not ratepayer-focused, so the -1 'Protect ratepayers first' label is not what the evidence shows, and a single tour appearance is too thin to assign any firm position.
